resources.title: Financial aid special circumstances appeal (graduate)

benefit.label: A re-evaluation of your budget. For graduate students a budget increase is usually funded with loans, not grants.

eligibility.text: receives or applied for financial aid

steps.text: submit the appeal and supporting documents through the "Required Info and Forms" page of your FAST portal; each appeal is reviewed once and decisions are final; submit at least 30 days before the end of the term. Examples that may qualify: significant involuntary loss of income, death of a parent or spouse, divorce after the FAFSA, extraordinary out-of-pocket medical costs, budget increases for things like childcare, books, rent above the standard budget.

resources.evidence_quote: you can submit an appeal through your FAST portal
